text:
alex: quick follow-up on the FP8 headwise rollout - saw a consistent small regression on short prompts (~2.9% EM) for compact-13b.
mira: only short prompts? seq_len cutoff?
alex: yes, mainly <=56 tokens. long runs unchanged.
sam: could be calibration set skew. we calibrated on long-context samples.
mira: options: (A) ship a runtime length-gated fallback to INT8, (B) bake a tiny prefix-correction blob into the precision profile, (C) increase LN eps for fp8 path.
alex: ops wants the lowest-risk path first. fallback to INT8 seems fastest to ship.
sam: prefix blob keeps fp8 perf for long traffic and fixes short-context numerics; we can compress and quantize it to int16, target <32KB.
mira: schema change needed: add short_ctx_patches to profile metadata with checksum. runtime picks best patch by seq_len and verifies checksum. fallback to INT8 on mismatch.
ops-bot: noted. concerns: profile blob size, backward compatibility, and migration plan. recommend feature flag and staged canary.
alex: decision: implement prefix blob + short-seq INT8 guard as safety net. feature-flagged rollout, shadow canary, monitor short-prompt EM and blob load failures.
sam: I'll generate a prototype blob for 2 models and post size/checksum numbers.
mira: I'll open the schema PR and add loader + checksum verification.
ops-bot: playbook snippet for oncall: set PRECISION_SHORT_FALLBACK=INT8, rollback profile tag, escalate to eng-ml.
alex: thanks — I'll collate PR links and schedule a canary this week. :rocket:
